---
title: "Search"
page-layout: full
body-classes: pg search-page
sidebar: false
toc: false
include-after-body:
  - text: |
      <script type="module" src="/static/js/search.js"></script>
listing:
  # Every post, read by the script as data. A new post shows up on its own. template-params.section is the section name the filters use for posts.
  - id: search-posts
    template: ../_templates/search-records.ejs
    template-params:
      section: Writing
    fields: [date, title, description, categories, reading-time]
    date-format: "D MMM YYYY"
    sort: "date desc"
    contents:
      - ../posts/20*.qmd
      - ../posts/20*/index.qmd
  # Every other page, in the order the filters list them. Fields: title, href (a path from the site root, so projects.html, not ../projects.html and not an external URL), section (one of the names in the script settings below), description. Add match-body: false to match only the title and description of a page whose own text is interface chrome.
  - id: search-pages
    template: ../_templates/search-records.ejs
    sort: false
    contents:
      - title: Work
        href: projects.html
        section: Work
        description: Open source projects, live tools and gists. Most of the code is on GitHub.
      - title: India Weather
        href: india-weather.html
        section: Work
        match-body: false
        description: Live temperature, humidity, and air quality across India's major metropolitan cities.
      - title: Tools
        href: tools/
        section: Tools
        description: Browser-based tools that run entirely client-side. No data leaves your browser.
      - title: Image Format Converter
        href: tools/image-converter.html
        section: Tools
        description: Convert images between PNG, JPEG, and WebP with adjustable quality and transparency handling.
      - title: Image Resizer
        href: tools/image-resizer.html
        section: Tools
        description: Resize images by dimensions, percentage, or fit-within bounds with aspect ratio lock and format options.
      - title: Image Cropper
        href: tools/image-cropper.html
        section: Tools
        description: Interactively crop images with draggable selection, aspect ratio presets, and full-resolution output.
      - title: Binary Mask Creator
        href: tools/image-mask-creator.html
        section: Tools
        description: Paint binary black-and-white masks for AI inpainting with brush, eraser, undo, and invert options.
      - title: Image Adjust & Transform
        href: tools/image-operations.html
        section: Tools
        description: Flip, rotate, invert colors, convert to grayscale, and adjust brightness and contrast.
      - title: SVG Viewer & Converter
        href: tools/svg-viewer.html
        section: Tools
        description: Preview SVG files with zoom and background controls, inspect metadata and source, and export to PNG, JPEG, or WebP at any scale.
      - title: HTML Viewer
        href: tools/html-viewer.html
        section: Tools
        description: Paste or drop HTML code to preview it rendered in a sandboxed iframe. Side-by-side editor and preview with toggleable background.
      - title: Markdown Viewer
        href: tools/markdown-viewer.html
        section: Tools
        description: Paste or drop Markdown for live GFM-rendered preview with syntax-highlighted code blocks and LaTeX math support. Export rendered HTML.
      - title: JSON Formatter & Viewer
        href: tools/json-formatter.html
        section: Tools
        description: Paste or drop JSON to format with syntax highlighting, collapsible tree view, validation with line-level error reporting, search, and one-click copy.
      - title: Diff Viewer
        href: tools/diff-viewer.html
        section: Tools
        description: Compare two text blocks with line-level and word-level diff highlighting. Side-by-side and unified diff modes.
      - title: LaTeX Math Preview
        href: tools/latex-preview.html
        section: Tools
        description: Type LaTeX and see it rendered instantly with KaTeX. Per-equation error feedback, symbol palette, render mode toggle, and saved snippets.
      - title: YAML ↔ JSON Converter
        href: tools/yaml-json-converter.html
        section: Tools
        description: Convert between YAML and JSON with live validation, configurable indentation, file drop support, and sample data.
      - title: Base64 Encoder/Decoder
        href: tools/base64.html
        section: Tools
        description: Decode base64 to image with live preview and download, encode images to base64 data URIs (drag-and-drop), or encode/decode plain text.
      - title: URL Encoder/Decoder
        href: tools/url-encoder.html
        section: Tools
        description: Percent-encode and decode URL strings with live conversion. Toggle between encodeURIComponent and encodeURI modes.
      - title: About
        href: about.html
        section: About
        description: Forward deployed ML engineer at Applied Computing. My path from TU Delft and Shell to Flixstock and Jiffy, and contract work.
      - title: Publications
        href: publications.html
        section: Research
        description: Journal papers and conference talks from my PhD and research years.
      - title: DOVER-Lap
        href: pages/doverlap.html
        section: Research
        description: The code for DOVER-Lap, publicly available under the MIT license.
      - title: "Integration of speech separation, diarization, and recognition for multi-speaker meetings"
        href: pages/jsalt.html
        section: Research
        description: How to reproduce and extend our pipeline of speech separation, diarization and ASR, with separated audio files and end-to-end recipes.
      - title: Multi-class Spectral Clustering with Overlaps for Speaker Diarization
        href: pages/overlap-aware-sc.html
        section: Research
        description: The implementation of our SLT 2021 paper, an overlap detector and a modified spectral clustering method for overlap-aware diarization.
---

```{=html}
<div class="search-app">
  <div class="search-live" hidden>
    <div class="search-field">
      <input class="search-input" type="search" placeholder="Search the site" aria-label="Search the site" autocomplete="off" autocapitalize="off" spellcheck="false" enterkeyhint="search">
      <button class="search-clear" type="button" hidden>Clear</button>
    </div>
    <div class="search-bar">
      <div class="search-filters" role="group" aria-label="Filter by section"></div>
      <p class="search-mode">Keyword search</p>
    </div>
    <div class="search-topics" hidden>
      <span class="search-topics-label">Topics</span>
      <div class="search-topic-list" role="group" aria-label="Topics"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="search-head">
      <h2 class="search-heading no-anchor" hidden></h2>
      <p class="search-count" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </div>
    <ol class="list post-rows search-rows"></ol>
    <button class="search-more" type="button" aria-expanded="false" hidden></button>
  </div>
  <noscript><p class="search-note">Search needs JavaScript.</p></noscript>
  <!-- Words and settings for static/js/search.js. root is the path from this page to the site root, put in front of every result link, and indexUrl is the passage index that scripts/build-search-index.mjs writes after every render. {count}, {shown}, {name} and {query} are filled in by the script. The controls start hidden and the script shows them, so with JavaScript off only the note shows. none is for a keyword-only search with no match; nearest is for a search with no keyword match once the meaning files have loaded, which lists the few pages closest by meaning. The choice labels are the spoken names of the filter and topic buttons. vectorsUrl is the file of passage vectors that scripts/build-search-vectors.mjs writes next to the index; it names the embedding table and vocabulary in static/search, and the page uses meaning search only when all three match the index. bestCount is how many rows a search lists before the Show all control. all and sections are the filter names, and a page's section must be one of sections. The stop words are left out of a query unless it has nothing else. -->
  <script type="application/json" class="search-copy">
  {
    "root": "../",
    "indexUrl": "../search-index.json",
    "vectorsUrl": "../search-vectors.json",
    "all": "All",
    "sections": ["Writing", "Work", "Tools", "About", "Research"],
    "latest": "Latest writing",
    "latestCount": 5,
    "count": "{count} results",
    "countOne": "1 result",
    "countBest": "Best {shown} of {count} results",
    "bestCount": 8,
    "showAll": "Show all {count} results",
    "showBest": "Show the best {shown}",
    "none": "No results for \"{query}\". Try a shorter phrase or pick a topic.",
    "nearest": "No exact matches for \"{query}\". These {count} pages are the closest by meaning.",
    "nearestOne": "No exact matches for \"{query}\". This page is the closest by meaning.",
    "choiceLabel": "{name}, {count} results",
    "choiceLabelOne": "{name}, 1 result",
    "topicLabel": "{name}, {count} posts",
    "topicLabelOne": "{name}, 1 post",
    "modeHybrid": "Keyword and meaning search",
    "modeFallback": "Titles and descriptions only",
    "stopWords": ["a", "an", "and", "are", "as", "at", "be", "by", "do", "does", "for", "from", "how", "i", "in", "is", "it", "me", "my", "of", "on", "or", "that", "the", "this", "to", "was", "what", "when", "where", "which", "who", "why", "with", "you", "your"]
  }
  </script>
</div>
```
